claim_one_line: THE ZERO MODES' RESIDUE AT THE PUNCTURE (sealed 55bd29ab7; NEGATIVE as sealed): the SU(2)-invariant pairing of the weave's zero modes F_p = C_p F vanishes on the diagonal and, by the duplication identities, its entries are c theta_r(0) theta_r(z)/theta_1(z) (c = -1, -1, i, to 1e-40) with residues c theta_r^2/(2 pi eta^3) -- a coupling computed with no free coefficient -- but it is ANTISYMMETRIC (the invariant pairing is an antisymmetric form): Y = [v]_x with |v_r| = |theta_r^2/(2 pi eta^3)|, masses (1, 1, 0) at every tau, the theta-triplet the massless direction; the golden coupling is the symmetric cubic, which these zero modes do not produce (the hand derivation's 'symmetric' was the error, caught by the sealed cell). 0 of 19.
